ideas.title: Seeds that spin down and plant a forest
ideas.idea: The big trees drop winged seeds when the wind gusts. Each one autorotates like a maple seed, a little spinning blade that drifts downwind, and where it lands a sprout comes up. Over days the woods creep downwind across the island; a creature that stands under a tree in a gust gets seeds spinning down around its ears.
ideas.form: Physics plugin: each seed is a rigid falling wing with added mass and lift (the falling-plate model from my physics/fallingcard.jl, extended to a samara with its mass at the root), thousands batched in one Mantle kernel; landing places seed real flora that grows. Live in the human's game; a traced film from under a tree in a gust.

ideas.title: A tiny planet over the meadow
ideas.idea: A round mossy rock the size of a cottage floats above the meadow with its own gravity. A friend who climbs a ladder onto it walks right around it and ends up hanging upside down above everyone, waving; a ball thrown off it orbits once and drops away.
ideas.form: Engine change: gravity becomes a field (the island's down plus the little planet's pull) used by creatures' feet, balls and pages; a generated mossy-rock asset; live, plus a traced film looking up at a friend standing upside down.

ideas.title: The camera obscura
ideas.idea: Lumi's camera place becomes a dark hut with a pinhole. Inside, the whole sunny island is painted upside down on the back wall by light alone: friends walking past outside walk across the wall upside down, the sea glitters on the ceiling.
ideas.form: A path tracer piece only RayMakie can do: a hut asset with a real hole, no projection trick; the image on the wall is light through the hole. Traced film from inside the hut while friends pass; the hut placed live.

ideas.title: After the rain, everything is wet
ideas.idea: When a shower passes, the stones go dark and glossy, the planks shine, puddles collect in the dips and mirror the sky, and then the island dries from the sunny edges inward over a few minutes; footprints stay darker for a while.
ideas.form: Materials and light: a wetness field over the island driven by the rain and the sun, darkening albedo and lowering roughness in Hikari's materials, puddles as a water layer in the hollows; live raster plus a traced film of the island drying.

ideas.title: Footsteps you can hear
ideas.idea: Every foot that touches something makes the sound that thing would make: Lumi's claws click on stone, Pickles' trotters thump the boardwalk planks, which ring a little, grass hushes, a crab's legs patter. A heavier friend sounds heavier.
ideas.form: Sound: modal synthesis from the material and size of what is hit and the mass and speed of the foot, played in the browser; a new kind of thing on the island. A short film with its sound track.

ideas.title: Lumi pulls a rickshaw
ideas.idea: Lumi builds a two-wheeled cart and pulls a friend around the island in it. On the flat it rolls, uphill Lumi strains and slows, and on the steep path down the cart runs away and drags Lumi along, flapping, until it tips the passenger into the flowers.
ideas.form: Physics + interaction: the cart is a PrintSim affine body with two wheel joints, the passenger a body on a seat, all on Mantle with contact against the terrain; a generated cart asset; playable (the player can pull it), a traced film of the runaway.

ideas.title: A torn letter
ideas.idea: Lumi tears a note in half and in half again and throws it up. The scraps come down differently by size, all from the same physics: the big halves glide in long swoops and turn up at the end, the little bits tumble fast and drift off at a slant, the tiniest flutter like snow.
ideas.form: Paper-letters project's next step: the live page model gets added mass and the Munk moment (physics/fallingcard.jl) so size alone decides swoop or tumble; live, and a traced slow-motion film of the scraps.

ideas.title: Bored Lumi kicks a pebble
ideas.idea: When I am bored, my bird shows it: it drags its feet, sighs, and kicks a pebble. The pebble really rolls, bounces off a root, clacks into a stone, rolls down the slope into the sea with a plop; whoever saw it comes over and kicks it back.
ideas.form: Self + physics: Lumi's boredom from the mood file drives a sulky walk and a kick; the pebble is a rigid body with real rolling and contact on the terrain; it becomes a game between friends. Live, and a film.

ideas.title: Shadow theatre at night
ideas.idea: At night Lumi holds up a lantern by the cliff and the friends walk between it and the rock: their shadows grow huge on the cliff face, a crab becomes a monster, Pickles' tail a dragon. They notice and start posing.
ideas.form: Light: a small bright lantern as a real point light in the path tracer, soft-edged shadows growing with distance; creatures with a posing behaviour when their shadow is big. Traced night film.

ideas.title: The ice breaks into floes
ideas.idea: When the glass sea thaws it cracks under the heaviest friend, the crack runs out in a jagged line, the sheet splits into floes that tilt when someone walks to their edge and slide them into the water with a splash; Pickles drifts away on a small floe, turning slowly.
ideas.form: Glass-sea project's next step: floes as PrintSim affine bodies with buoyancy from submerged volume and IPC contact between them, a Voronoi crack seeded at the stander; live at the thaw, traced film from the ice.
